caption: Figure 6 | Full-model and native monthly SatPM V6.GL.03 performance on matched station-months. (A) RMSE for the two estimates across 12 country–year–profile combinations: fixed 2023, fixed 2024 and rolling 2024. Filled circles denote the full model and open squares SatPM. (B) Paired ΔRMSE (full minus SatPM) with station-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals (500 resamples; seed 20261116). Negative differences favor the full model. The 2023 difference favors SatPM in the United States and the full model in Canada; all 2024 RMSE intervals include zero. Rows group country, year and update policy, with meteorological profiles offset. Units are µg m⁻³.
